response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS a FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref HAVING AVG(humepct) IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS ga FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.equipref, p.a, g.ga FROM per p CROSS JOIN g WHERE g.ga IS NOT NULL AND p.a > g.ga), k AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS ka FROM kept), r AS (SELECT kept.equipref, kept.a AS avg_humidity, kept.a - kept.ga AS excess_over_overall_avg, kept.a - k.ka AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept CROSS JOIN k WHERE k.ka IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT r.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC) AS rk FROM r) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, excess_over_overall_avg, diff_from_kept_mean FROM ranked WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC

assumptions.assumption: The all-equipment average is the mean of the per-equipment average humidities (each equipment weighted equally), not the mean of all individual readings. Equipment with no non-null readings has no average and is left out of that mean.
Ties with the 10th row are handled with RANK() over the difference from the kept-equipment mean, so all rows tied at rank 10 or better are returned.
